title: Sting’s silent war against the nWo
summary: An impostor causes WCW’s wrestlers to doubt Sting’s loyalty. He withdraws, adopts a darker identity and slowly turns his attention toward taking Hogan’s championship.

chapters.title: The fake Sting attacks Luger
chapters.result: An nWo impostor appearing as Sting attacks Lex Luger.
chapters.context: The deception undermines trust in WCW’s franchise star.

chapters.title: Sting walks away from his doubters
chapters.result: Sting addresses WCW’s distrust and withdraws from its usual alliance.
chapters.context: The break starts his transition toward the silent, black-and-white figure watching from above.

chapters.title: Sting wins a controversial main event
chapters.result: Sting defeats Hogan after Bret Hart restarts the match.
chapters.context: The intended triumph is clouded by the disputed finish and later title vacancy.

chapters.title: Sting wins the vacant championship
chapters.result: Sting defeats Hogan for the vacant WCW World title.
chapters.context: The rematch supplies another championship payoff, with Savage’s involvement reflecting new fractures in the nWo.
